title: Happy Holidays!

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi leveled up her big-kid skills! 🎓
Now follow Kimi through a whole year of festivals — every one is a party!

scenes.title: New Year, New Kimi!
scenes.caption:
New clothes, a big bow,
and Grandma's house smells like dumplings!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's go to Grandma's place with our new clothes on to give a big bow to her.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You look prettier with your new clothes on!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Time to give a big bow to the adults! Have a happy new year! 🧧

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: We eat a family reunion dinner. You get one year older when you eat it!

scenes.title: The Round Moon Party
scenes.caption:
The moon is big and round tonight.
So are the mooncakes!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Is it already Mid-Autumn Festival next week?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's on August 15 on the lunar calendar. The moon will be round on that day.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I can't wait to eat mooncakes! 🥮

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's go outside to have a barbecue party. Hope the weather will be fine at night!

scenes.title: The Best Day Ever
scenes.caption:
Presents, good food, and fun plans —
it's KIMI'S day!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yay! Children's Day is coming soon! 🎈

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What present do you want on Children's Day?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I want a new Lego set! And I want to go to an amusement park!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Grandpa sent you a big present. Call Grandpa and say thank you.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I wish every day were Children's Day!

scenes.title: Santa Is Coming
scenes.caption:
A star on top, stockings by the tree...
and one VERY excited little girl.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's put up our Christmas tree. Let's put a star on the top! ⭐

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Oops, I forgot to put up the stockings!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Have you been a good child for the entire year? Santa only visits good kids.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look! Santa put a present under the tree! I want to open my present! 🎁

songs: 🔁 Replay all your favorites from Episodes 1-10!

ending.title: A Whole Year of Fun!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Around the Town! 🏙️
